legalName: Petition for Mandatory Mistaken-Identity Expungement Under C.R.S. § 24-72-702 (Participant Filing After the Expired 90-Day Agency Deadline)
boundReferenceRole: none — this family composes from committed records; no official binary is bound and none is included

componentConditions.proposed_order: Travels with the petition only; nothing on it is decided, signed or dated by the participant.

routeSelectionNote: One route, one instrument set: the petition states the participant-files-after-90-days ground of § 24-72-702 in its own title and body, and no election control exists on any composed page. The no-agency-finding fork is a route boundary, not a choice inside this packet: the recorded rule is that with no finding the first output is a written request to the agency for investigation and finding, which is a different branch's instrument, and this packet tells that participant to stop.
